newsitem.title: USA: Protein Databases Inc in funding crisis.
newsitem.headline: Protein Databases Inc in funding crisis.

text.p: Protein Databases Inc said Friday its liquidity position is "critical" and it needs higher sales or more funding to continue operations after June 30.

On April 8 the company said it entered into a letter of intent to sell all of its intellectual property, fixed assets and property, plant and equipment for $1 million, subject to the buyer's completion of due diligence, the approval of the board of directors of the buyer, the approval of the company's board of directors and shareholders and certain other conditions.
The company does not anticipate this sale will be completed before June 30, 1997.

Protein Databases Inc has developed and markets intelligent scanning densitometers and low level light detection systems that are sold to life science research laboratories at university, government, hospital and industrial (biotech and pharmaceutical) institutions.
